description: CREATES a payment (request an authorization, or an immediate capture) — this MOVES MONEY: it charges a card / payment source. Checkout.com: POST /payments. Provide `amount` (minor units), `currency`, and a `source` object such as { type: 'token', token: 'tok_...' }, { type: 'id', id: 'src_...' } (a saved instrument), or { type: 'customer', id: 'cus_...' }.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's MINOR units (e.g. 1000 = $10.00; 0 = card verification). Required.

capture.description: If true (default for card), capture immediately; if false, authorize only.

customer.description: Customer object to associate/create, e.g. { id:'cus_...' } or { email, name }.

description.description: Description shown on the customer's statement / for your records.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — sent as the Cko-Idempotency-Key header to safely retry.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata to attach to the payment.

processing_channel_id.description: Processing channel id ('pc_...') to route the payment through.

reference.description: Your reference for the payment (e.g. order id).

source.description: Payment source object. Required. E.g. { type:'token', token:'tok_...' }, { type:'id', id:'src_...' }, or { type:'customer', id:'cus_...' }.

name: checkout_create_payment
title: Create payment
